title: Local-discovery schema audit STILL OPEN (6th week) - five near-me / 'restaurants <city>' queries lost outright this period and non-branded impressions fell 16% (182,503 -> 153,044)
detail: Sixth consecutive carry-forward, and this is now the only structural item on the list that has never moved - every other high-priority flag from last run resolved on its own this period (see the wins item below), which makes this the highest-value remaining work by elimination. Five local-discovery queries dropped to zero clicks: 'vegetarian restaurants near me' (was pos 4.5), 'mediterranean food near me' (was 8.3), 'grain bowls near me' (was 7.8), 'restaurants in pewaukee' (was 14.0), and 'middleton restaurants' (was 21.2). That is up from four lost last period and three the period before, so the erosion is accelerating. Two of these - 'vegetarian restaurants near me' at 4.5 and 'grain bowls near me' at 7.8 - were ranking on page one and are exactly the queries a complete LocalBusiness markup is supposed to hold. Meanwhile the surviving generics are soft: 'food near me' lost 24 clicks at a dead-flat position 11.5, and 'healthy food near me' lost 21 clicks even though its position IMPROVED 7.6 -> 7.0 (demand, not rank, on that one). Non-branded clicks fell to 1,678 (-174, -9.4%) on impressions down 16%. Action, unchanged and mechanical: confirm EVERY /locations/* page carries name, full postal address, geo lat/long, openingHoursSpecification, telephone, servesCuisine, and hasMenu, plus an embedded Google map. Validate two pages side by side in the Rich Results Test - Brookfield or Middleton (both winning hard this period) against State Street (the weakest page on the site) - and port whatever the winners have. Budget an hour; it has been deferred six weeks and is the one item that compounds.

title: ESCALATED - State Street CTR stuck at 0.95% for a 6th week while ranking fine at position 4.4; Milwaukee Public Market converts 4.6% at the SAME position, a gap worth ~+130 clicks/28d
detail: Promoting this from a footnote to its own high-priority item because six weeks of data have now ruled out every explanation except the one that is cheap to fix. State Street took 60 clicks (-5) from 6,310 impressions at position 4.4. The position is healthy and stable (4.5 -> 4.4) - this page is NOT a ranking problem, so no amount of schema or link work will move it. It is a click-through problem, and the comparison is direct: /locations/milwaukee-public-market sits at the identical position 4.3 and converts 4.6% (295 clicks from 6,447 impressions). Monona converts 4.0% at position 3.2, Pewaukee 4.6% at 3.3. State Street is the only location page below 1%. Pulling it to even a conservative 3% would yield roughly 190 clicks against today's 60 - about +130 clicks per 28 days from a title and meta-description rewrite, no ranking change required. Action: rewrite the <title> and meta description to lead with 'State Street' and 'UW-Madison campus' rather than the generic location-page template, since the searcher is almost certainly a student or campus visitor who does not recognize the current snippet as the right store; add hours and 'order online' to the description; and add a homepage link to the page. Then re-check CTR in two runs - if it does not move above 2%, the next suspect is a wrong or missing image in the snippet.

title: NEW - /blogs/secret-behind-forbidden-rice losing actual rank, not just demand: 'black rice' fell 8.4 -> 11.3 off page one (-50 clicks) and 'forbidden rice' 7.2 -> 8.2; page -102 clicks
detail: Calling this out separately because it is the one blog decline this period that is a genuine ranking loss rather than the AI-overview demand absorption affecting everything else, and the distinction changes what you do about it. 'black rice' dropped from position 8.4 to 11.3 - a 2.9-point fall that pushes it off page one entirely - and clicks collapsed 75 -> 25. 'forbidden rice' slipped 7.2 -> 8.2 and lost 26 clicks. The parent page /blogs/secret-behind-forbidden-rice fell 7.7 -> 8.6 and shed 102 clicks. CONTRAST that proves the point: /blogs/fermented-food lost far more impressions (-23,118, -28%) but its position is dead flat at 8.7 vs 8.8, and 'fermented foods' held 8.4 -> 8.6 - that one is pure demand absorption and should be ignored, exactly as recommended the last four runs. Forbidden rice is different: position worsened on both head terms while the page still carries 78,668 impressions, making it the largest informational asset on the site and the only one actively losing ground in the rankings. Action: refresh the post - check publish/updated date, expand thin sections (cooking method, nutrition comparison, where to buy), add an internal link from /blogs/farro-vs-quinoa (which is gaining, +40 clicks) and from /menu where black rice appears as an ingredient. If a competitor has taken the slot, compare word count and heading structure against whatever now ranks 8-10 for 'black rice'.

title: Branded-variant reshuffle continues: 'forage sun prairie' -68 clicks (-42%) and pos 1.2 -> 1.9 even though its PAGE recovered to 2.3; 'forage hilldale' 1.4 -> 2.4; watch item, not yet a problem
detail: Logging this as a watch item rather than an alarm, because the page-level evidence contradicts the query-level evidence and the page is what matters. Sun Prairie was flagged high three runs straight for a monotonic position decline (2.2 -> 2.6 -> 2.9); that decline REVERSED hard this period - the page is at 2.3, clicks jumped 382 -> 482 (+26%), and impressions rose 1,269 after two periods of losses. So the page is healthy and the prior escalation is closed. But the short branded query 'forage sun prairie' went the other way: position 1.2 -> 1.9 and clicks 162 -> 94, a 42% drop and the steepest click decline of any location query. 'forage kitchen sun prairie menu' also slipped 3.7 -> 4.8. The same split shows at Hilldale ('forage hilldale' 1.4 -> 2.4 while still gaining 11 clicks, page position improving 4.0 -> 3.5) and at Pewaukee ('forage pewaukee' 1.2 -> 6.4, though on only 67 impressions, which is too small a sample to trust). This is the variant-reshuffle pattern noted in prior runs - traffic moving between query spellings while the destination page holds - and in every case here the page gained or held. Action: no structural work yet. At the next run, check whether 'forage sun prairie' clicks recovered; if it is still down AND the page position has slipped back above 3.0, treat it as a real Sun Prairie ranking problem and pull the Google Business Profile comparison against Middleton that has been deferred. Until both move together, do not spend time on it.

title: Monona is the one location page down on clicks past the threshold: -54 clicks (-17%) on impressions -33% (10,074 -> 6,757) - but position IMPROVED 3.5 -> 3.2, so this is demand, not rank
detail: Flagging because it crosses the -15% click threshold, with the read attached so it is not over-chased. Monona took 271 clicks against 325, a 17% decline, and lost a third of its impressions (-3,317). Every ranking signal, however, moved the right way or held: the page position IMPROVED to 3.2 from 3.5, and the primary branded query 'forage kitchen monona' held position 1.1 dead flat while losing 65 clicks. Better position plus far fewer impressions plus stable #1 branded rank is the textbook demand-side signature - fewer people in that market searched, and the ones who did still found the store first. No ranking intervention is warranted. It is worth a non-SEO check though: Monona is the only market showing this pattern while Brookfield (+172), Middleton (+108), Champaign (+104) and Sun Prairie (+100) all posted large gains, so a 33% impression drop stands out against a network that is otherwise growing. Action: (1) Confirm nothing changed operationally - hours, a temporary closure, a construction or access issue, or a new competitor opening nearby. (2) Cross-check Monona's actual transaction counts against the same 28 days in the daily sales dashboard; if store sales are flat while search demand fell a third, the search drop is a measurement or local-pack artifact and can be ignored. If sales fell too, this is a market issue for operations, not SEO.

title: Strong period overall - THREE high-priority flags resolved at once (/menu 6.6 -> 4.2, Whitefish Bay fully recovered, /faq 7.4 -> 5.0) while site CTR hit 3.76% and average position improved 9.0 -> 8.4
detail: Context, and an unusually good week for follow-through. RESOLVED - /menu: flagged high two runs straight for a slide to 6.6; it recovered 2.4 points to position 4.2, the largest page-position gain on the site. Clicks fell 341, but on impressions down 2,392 and with rank sharply better, that is demand, not the ranking loss previously diagnosed. Closing it. RESOLVED - Whitefish Bay: re-escalated last run when all four signals moved wrong at once; all four have now moved back. Page 3.3 -> 2.9, 'forage kitchen whitefish bay' 2.8 -> 1.3 (+33 clicks, back to #1), 'forage whitefish bay' 2.0 -> 1.3, and it remains the highest-click location page at 626. No action needed; the drift stopped on its own. RESOLVED - /faq: re-opened last run for a 2.2-point drop masked by rising clicks; it recovered the full amount, 7.4 -> 5.0, and clicks rose again to 471 (+130). 'forage kitchen nutrition' went 2.2 -> 1.1, back to the top slot. The FAQPage schema is evidently intact. TOP LINE: clicks 23,236 (-641, -2.7%), impressions 617,570 (-9.3%), CTR improved 3.51% -> 3.76%, and site average position improved 9.0 -> 8.4. Branded clicks were essentially flat (16,448, -148, -0.9%), so the softness is entirely in the informational long tail. The impression decline stays concentrated in blog posts whose positions are flat - continued AI-overview absorption, unchanged guidance: do not chase it. OTHER WINS: Brookfield +172 clicks with position 4.2 -> 3.3, still ramping six months after opening; Middleton +108 with a 2.9-point position gain (5.9 -> 3.0); Champaign +104 and position 6.5 -> 4.3 as the fall semester lands, retiring the last of its escalation; /careers impressions +6,647 on hiring-season demand.
